liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Top three transition; Brent and Jerry interplay featured on Dick's Pick's 13; Long, spacey jam tests limits before exploding into joyous smiling fragments of psychedelic extacy [13][18]
- **Mexicali Blues** (1 review): Garcia turns on his mutron, creating an Estimated-wah sound during the initial part [20]
- **The Promised Land** (1 review): Garcia's second solo is taken almost entirely in chords, checking out what it sounds like [20]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Really trippy Terrapin to Playin' In The Band; classic Nassau rowdy east coast show [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-11-01.sbd.miller.23445.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 193 min; rated 4.63/5 by 35 [1]
- **gd79-11-01.sbd.clugston.5586.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 191 min; rated 4.08/5 by 13 [3]. Said about its sound: First generation cassette is slightly fast and has improper Dolby decoding; Soundboard allows clear distinction between Jerry and Bobby's guitars [12][17]
- **gd1979-11-01.sbd-repatched.miller.77363.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 193 min; rated 4/5 by 4 [4]
- **gd1979-11-01.sbd.miller.78301.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 193 min; rated 5/5 by 5 [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer recalls seeing Bobby play fragmented chords and odd harmonics up close [17]
- This Scarlet to Fire appears as a hidden track on Dick's Pick's 13 [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-11-01.sbd.miller.23445.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Black Peter to US Blues section was grabbed from the other source; First circulation of the Cassette Master; previous copy was actually a fast 1st Gen; Master Audience Cassette recorded via Nakamichi CM300 mics into Nakamichi 550, then CDR [1][14]
- **gd79-11-01.sbd.clugston.5586.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Master Soundboard Cassette played back via Nakamichi DR-3 to RME 96/8 PST to Harddrive; Patches sourced from Master Soundboard, Cassette, Hi-Fi VHS, and Master Audience Cassette [3]
- **gd1979-11-01.sbd-repatched.miller.77363.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Cassette (Sony TCD5M/UDXL-II) -> Master Dat (Panasonic SV3800/48k) [4]. Also: Repatch of shnid23445 using Master Audience Cassette source with Nakamichi CM300 mics [4]
- **gd1979-11-01.sbd.miller.78301.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Cassette (Sony TCD5M/UDXL-II) -> Master Dat (Panasonic SV3800/48k) [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Marsia Tunis Grateful Dead: [1979-11-01 Nassau Coliseum, Uniondale, NY, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1979-11-01-nassau-coliseum-uniondale-ny-usa/) [25]
